text: Loom for DeepSeek Harness 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的对话分支与创作插件。它将 Loom Remote 服务和浏览器界面接入 Harness，在会话中创建多个回答分支，编辑提示词继续探索，并可浏览分支族。代码工作流支持在 Git worktree 中隔离分支、比较各自的变更和测试摘要，再查看差异并应用或保留选定分支。Weave 提供独立的 prose 接续、候选选择和 token 探索。适合需要并行比较模型回答、代码修改方案或创作续写的 Harness 用户；模型生成使用 Harness 中配置的路由与凭据，可能产生模型服务费用。

Loom for DeepSeek Harness adds branching, worktree comparison, and Weave to Harness Web. Create alternative session branches, inspect code diffs, then apply or keep changes. Weave generates prose separately from Chat. Generation uses configured Harness models and may incur provider charges.
我想让同一段对话生成几个不同回答，方便并排挑选。
能不能改写某轮提示词，再从那里开一条新会话分支？
想把模型提出的不同代码修改放进独立 Git worktree 里比较。
如何查看各个分支改了哪些文件，并把选中的改动应用回来？
I want to explore several alternative replies from the same conversation without losing the original.
Can I generate and curate prose continuations separately from my chat history?
Loom for DeepSeek Harness 的功能「对话分支与回答探索」：从已有会话指定轮次重新生成、修改提示词或提供不同引导，为同一上下文创建多个子会话；原会话保持不变，用户可浏览分支族并标记取舍。
Loom for DeepSeek Harness 的功能「隔离比较代码修改」：可将分支放入 Git worktree，比较兄弟分支的运行状态、用量、文件差异和测试摘要，并查看统一 diff，随后应用、采用或丢弃分支。
Loom for DeepSeek Harness Weave creates separate prose continuations, with curation and token alternatives.
Loom 的分支、Weave 续写和自动探索会调用 Harness 中配置的模型路由，可能产生模型服务费用；模型凭据通过 Harness 设置配置。

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Loom for DeepSeek Harness：This community bundle targets **`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2`**. It installs through the original `dsh plugin` command and carries its own compatibility providers. You do not need the reference Harness fork to run it. Install the pinned npm alpha below or use the matching GitHub release tarball. Clean-profile installation, startup, removal, and feature checks pass. See [compatibility and validation status](https://github.com/scasella/dsh-loom/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.5/COMPATIBILITY.md) before installation.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Demo：The 3:54 captioned demo shows the same Loom features with real model calls on the [reference implementation](https://github.com/scasella/deepseek-harness/tree/77ccab27d200241ddf49d0ec9f5de1524343374f), with captured UI states and edited timing. [Full-quality MP4](https://github.com/scasella/dsh-loom/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha.3/Loom.mp4) · [Captions](https://github.com/scasella/dsh-loom/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha.3/Loom.srt).

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Features：- **Branch and read:** regenerate several answers, steer variants, edit prompts into branches, inspect requests and reasoning, and mark alternatives Keep or Set aside.
- **Compare code:** run competing edits in separate Git worktrees, compare tests, diffs, usage, and time, then apply a patch or adopt a branch.
- **Explore observations:** replace a recorded tool result in a fork and continue without rerunning that tool or adding a user message.
- **Write with Weave:** generate continuations at a cursor, retain siblings, inspect supported token probabilities, explore token alternatives, and export prose with curation records.
- **Navigate and delegate:** browse Multiverse families, search own or inherited messages, use keyboard and mobile controls, and let models explore under explicit budgets.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Features：The [Loom user guide](https://github.com/scasella/dsh-loom/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.5/docs/guide.md) covers every workflow. See the [documentation index](https://github.com/scasella/dsh-loom/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.5/docs/README.md) for configuration, compatibility, and [verification](https://github.com/scasella/dsh-loom/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.5/VERIFICATION.md). The npm package includes the English and Chinese user guides, configuration reference, and documentation index. The supported Harness/SDK versions are unchanged.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Features：Alpha.5 includes the [acceptance review fixes](https://github.com/scasella/dsh-loom/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.5/docs/review-resolutions.md): children return logged errors for human questions and approvals, empty Weave selections cannot export Chat, and Compare retains newly applied diffs. It also improves keyboard controls, branch labels, costs, request inspection, and model setup guidance.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Install：You need Node.js 24+ or Node.js 22.19+ within 22.x, Git 2.26+, pnpm on your PATH, and the official **`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2`** runtime with its installed `@earendil-works/pi-ai@1.3.0` SDK. The bundle refuses an unsupported SDK version. Install that exact runtime if needed:

```sh
npm install --global @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2
```

In a POSIX shell, install the pinned npm alpha in a separate home:

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Install：```sh
export DSH_HOME="$HOME/.dsh-loom"
dsh plugin --profile web add @scasella/dsh-loom@0.1.0-alpha.5
dsh web --no-open --port 3097
```

The [GitHub v0.1.0-alpha.5 tarball](https://github.com/scasella/dsh-loom/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha.5/scasella-dsh-loom-0.1.0-alpha.5.tgz) is an alternative installation source for this release. Download it, then use `dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/scasella-dsh-loom-0.1.0-alpha.5.tgz` with the same home.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Install：Open the URL printed by the launcher, including its local authentication token. This home and port leave a normal `~/.dsh` installation on port 3080 unchanged. Choose another unused port if 3097 is occupied. Set the same `DSH_HOME` each time you resume Loom. Restart the Web instance after installation or removal.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Install：If you already have custom profiles or model settings, read [configuration migration](https://github.com/scasella/dsh-loom/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.5/COMPATIBILITY.md#configuration-migration) before using an existing home. This bundle replaces selected providers only in the profile where you install it. Other runtime versions are unsupported; do not bypass a version refusal.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · First run：1. Open **Settings → Models**, enter your provider credentials, and select a model in the composer. Credentials belong in Harness settings, outside this package.
2. Choose a disposable workspace and start a conversation. After a settled turn, including a failed one, open **Loom** beside Chat.
3. Use **Regenerate ×2**, then switch between children in **Read** and mark a favorite **Keep**. Open **Multiverse** in the sidebar to browse families.
4. For code edits, select worktree isolation before branching and inspect **Compare**. Use a Git repository with at least one commit and allow workspace writes.
5. Open **Weave** for prose. Configure an explicitly capable route using the [Weave provider setup](docs/configuration.md#weave-provider-setup); a catalog model alone does not enable assistant prefixes or probabilities.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · First run：Each branch, prose continuation, and token probe can make paid model calls. Start with small counts. No prices ship by default; configured dollar figures are list-price estimates. Set autonomous branch, depth, token, and optional dollar budgets before model-driven exploration.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Saved data and removal：Session histories, prose, and choices persist. Branch queues and autonomous budgets live in Host memory and do not resume after restart. Worktrees copy tracked changes, exclude untracked and ignored files, and do not install dependencies. Apply requires a clean source checkout. Adopt retains histories and does not apply files or remove worktrees; use Apply or Discard for cleanup.

Export material you intend to keep, stop active branches, and clean up owned worktrees before removing the bundle:

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Saved data and removal：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @scasella/dsh-loom
```

Use the same home and profile, then restart. Models created in Loom remain saved under its compatibility entry and are hidden from the stock Models page after removal; reinstall Loom to restore them, or [transfer model settings before removal](COMPATIBILITY.md#return-to-stock-model-settings). Credentials and Session histories remain in the home. Experimental Loom records may need Loom enabled to render fully.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Build and license：The source project builds with `npm ci` and `npm run build`. `npm run pack:check` checks the actual npm pack list and scans packaged text for private files, machine paths, and unresolved source imports. Development sources are excluded from the installation tarball. See [COMPATIBILITY.md](https://github.com/scasella/dsh-loom/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.5/COMPATIBILITY.md) for supported versions, settings IDs, and validation scope.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Build and license：Maintainer instructions for continuous checks, trusted publishing, and tagged npm releases are in the [release guide](https://github.com/scasella/dsh-loom/blob/main/docs/releasing.md).

Loom derives from the archived reference fork at commit `77ccab27d200241ddf49d0ec9f5de1524343374f` and from [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), developed by DeepSeek AI. Third-party notices are in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/scasella/dsh-loom/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.5/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). This package is community maintained and is not an official DeepSeek release.

- **Compare code:** run competing edits in separate Git worktrees, compare tests, diffs, usage, and time, then apply a patch or adopt a branch.
- **Explore observations:** replace a recorded tool result in a fork and continue without rerunning that tool or adding a user message.
- **Write with Weave:** generate continuations at a cursor, retain siblings, inspect supported token probabilities, explore token alternatives, and export prose with curation records.
- **Navigate and delegate:** browse Multiverse families, search own or inherited messages, use keyboard and mobile controls, and let models explore under explicit budgets.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Features：The [Loom user guide](https://github.com/scasella/dsh-loom/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.5/docs/guide.md) covers every workflow. See the [documentation index](https://github.com/scasella/dsh-loom/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.5/docs/README.md) for configuration, compatibility, and [verification](https://github.com/scasella/dsh-loom/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.5/VERIFICATION.md). The npm package includes the English and Chinese user guides, configuration reference, and documentation index. The supported Harness/SDK versions are unchanged.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Features：Alpha.5 includes the [acceptance review fixes](https://github.com/scasella/dsh-loom/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.5/docs/review-resolutions.md): children return logged errors for human questions and approvals, empty Weave selections cannot export Chat, and Compare retains newly applied diffs. It also improves keyboard controls, branch labels, costs, request inspection, and model setup guidance.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Install：You need Node.js 24+ or Node.js 22.19+ within 22.x, Git 2.26+, pnpm on your PATH, and the official **`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2`** runtime with its installed `@earendil-works/pi-ai@1.3.0` SDK. The bundle refuses an unsupported SDK version. Install that exact runtime if needed:

```sh
npm install --global @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2
```

In a POSIX shell, install the pinned npm alpha in a separate home:

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Install：```sh
export DSH_HOME="$HOME/.dsh-loom"
dsh plugin --profile web add @scasella/dsh-loom@0.1.0-alpha.5
dsh web --no-open --port 3097
```

The [GitHub v0.1.0-alpha.5 tarball](https://github.com/scasella/dsh-loom/releases/download/v0.1.0-alpha.5/scasella-dsh-loom-0.1.0-alpha.5.tgz) is an alternative installation source for this release. Download it, then use `dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/scasella-dsh-loom-0.1.0-alpha.5.tgz` with the same home.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Install：Open the URL printed by the launcher, including its local authentication token. This home and port leave a normal `~/.dsh` installation on port 3080 unchanged. Choose another unused port if 3097 is occupied. Set the same `DSH_HOME` each time you resume Loom. Restart the Web instance after installation or removal.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Install：If you already have custom profiles or model settings, read [configuration migration](https://github.com/scasella/dsh-loom/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.5/COMPATIBILITY.md#configuration-migration) before using an existing home. This bundle replaces selected providers only in the profile where you install it. Other runtime versions are unsupported; do not bypass a version refusal.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · First run：1. Open **Settings → Models**, enter your provider credentials, and select a model in the composer. Credentials belong in Harness settings, outside this package.
2. Choose a disposable workspace and start a conversation. After a settled turn, including a failed one, open **Loom** beside Chat.
3. Use **Regenerate ×2**, then switch between children in **Read** and mark a favorite **Keep**. Open **Multiverse** in the sidebar to browse families.
4. For code edits, select worktree isolation before branching and inspect **Compare**. Use a Git repository with at least one commit and allow workspace writes.
5. Open **Weave** for prose. Configure an explicitly capable route using the [Weave provider setup](docs/configuration.md#weave-provider-setup); a catalog model alone does not enable assistant prefixes or probabilities.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · First run：Each branch, prose continuation, and token probe can make paid model calls. Start with small counts. No prices ship by default; configured dollar figures are list-price estimates. Set autonomous branch, depth, token, and optional dollar budgets before model-driven exploration.

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Saved data and removal：Session histories, prose, and choices persist. Branch queues and autonomous budgets live in Host memory and do not resume after restart. Worktrees copy tracked changes, exclude untracked and ignored files, and do not install dependencies. Apply requires a clean source checkout. Adopt retains histories and does not apply files or remove worktrees; use Apply or Discard for cleanup.

Export material you intend to keep, stop active branches, and clean up owned worktrees before removing the bundle:

@scasella/dsh-loom README · Saved data and removal：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @scasella/dsh-loom
```

Use the same home and profile, then restart. Models created in Loom remain saved under its compatibility entry and are hidden from the stock Models page after removal; reinstall Loom to restore them, or [transfer model settings before removal](COMPATIBILITY.md#return-to-stock-model-settings). Credentials and Session histories remain in the home. Experimental Loom records may need Loom enabled to render fully.

Development sources are excluded from the installation tarball.
